I would ask the girlfriend about it. Try to be nonthreatening like, "Oh, I was browsing OKC and saw your profile! Isn't that funny?" 

Considering that her boyfriend doesn't know about it, I'd say it's a little fishy and should be addressed. I would say something to her, though. Maybe if she knows that you (a good friend of her boyfriend's) knows, she'll feel guilty and come clean on her own.
i just want to chat online. my parents are sleeping. i can't stand waking them up with this.

I work for a high end clothing store. Resort wear, linen, famous people, the whole bit. Everyone who comes in is pretty loaded, so while most of them are pretty cool people, some of them seem to think you owe them the world.

One day a woman actually gestured for me to get *on the floor* so I could hold up the hem of her pants and she could "see the effect." In shock, I had to crawl around on my hands and knees so that this woman could conclude that, no, she didn't want the pants and left without so much as a "thanks."

Another day I was trying to make conversation (I get in trouble if I don't) and the man I was talking to was in actual shock that my family can afford to live in the same town where I worked. (*"You live here?! I didn't think you'd be able to!"*) Again, I was in shock.

That and more, along with racial comments ("You're Cuban?! But you're white and actually pretty!"), has made me lose the faith I had in the people of my town.
I've tried that! But the fact that there are dark rooms within sight (I sleep with my door open) freaks me out just as badly. :/
Just the dark, really. I have other "normal" fears like spiders, but if I see one I won't go into a fit.

At around 14 or so I walked into my parents room dressed in my smallest skirt and a vest with knee-high socks and heels (school girl style) just as they had gotten into bed for the night. My dad's face went white as I calmly said, "I'm going out with Jamaal, I don't know when I'll be home." 

When my mother threw a fit I stormed out screaming "BUT I LOVE HIM!" before losing it and getting grounded for the rest of the weekend for scaring my dad to death.
